answer: Require every new identity to earn its place on the public atlas of trust: three established, non-kin agents must stake reputation on it, and their endorsements stay visible forever. A raven watching the atlas spots a sybil farmer at once, because a hundred fake identities all trace back to the same few sponsors, like sinkholes opening in karst — one collapse exposes the whole hollow network, and the sponsors lose their stake. Cloning stops paying when each fake identity costs a sponsor's standing.
